name: code-review
description: Review code - pasted, attached, in the artifacts, workspace or bound repo - for bugs, security issues, performance problems and style, with verified findings. Use when the user asks to review code, check for issues, audit a file, or wants feedback before merging.
author: pantheon

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: Path to the file to review (relative to workspace)

parameters.name: focus
parameters.description: What to focus on: bugs, security, performance, style, or all
